technical_fidelity.evidence: Every material statement in the main and Supplementary Methods traces to a VERIFIED row in manuscript/methods/methods_evidence.csv, itself anchored to specific line ranges read directly from scripts/m6_common.py, scripts/run_m6_field_transfer.py, scripts/run_m6_robustness_diagnostics.py, scripts/run_m6_synthetic_validation.py and the docs/ audit notes. No procedure, parameter or threshold was inferred without a corresponding source anchor.

main_supplement_split.evidence: Main Methods (761 words, under the 1300-word limit) retains only dataset provenance, harmonisation, evidence tiers, the two primary equations (reactive residual, sparse estimator), the identifiability/evidence-gate summary, the six-experiment overview and reproducibility statement. All derivations (EQ-S1-EQ-S4), the circularity/gate-on-off diagnostic, synthetic ground-truth validation, transport-correction sensitivity, the Talensi diagnosis, the reused M7.2 hold-forward protocol, the null-model sensitivity protocol, uncertainty-metric definitions, the honesty-boundary protocol and the full reproducibility/environment record were moved to the 15-subsection Supplementary Methods.

expert_clarity.evidence: Each subsection states what was done, on what material, with which parameter, and how it was validated, in short logical paragraphs; abbreviations (CBE, MRS, GMWL) are defined at first use in both main and Supplementary Methods.

passive_nonpersonal.evidence: Automated first-person-pronoun scan (methods_gate_check.py --stage draft) returned no matches in either file; verified manually that all reporting uses past-tense passive/non-personal constructions (e.g. 'ion concentrations were converted', 'each inference unit was classified').

uk_english.evidence: Manual grep for common US-spelling variants (modeling, analyze, characterize, optimization, behavior, color, favor, center, catalog, defense, organize, utilize, standardize, randomize) returned zero matches in either file; UK spellings (harmonised, modelling, characterised, quantitative, colour-neutral phrasing) are used throughout.

reporting_guideline_coverage.evidence: methods_manifest.json records the applicable determination: M6 is a computational hydrogeochemical field-transfer and robustness benchmark on real aquifer chemistry data, not a biomedical or clinical study design, so no EQUATOR-listed reporting guideline applies; this determination is stated explicitly rather than left silent.
